001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel;
002
003
004import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
005import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
006import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
007import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel;
008import java.util.HashMap;
009import java.util.Map;
010import javax.inject.Inject;
011
012/**
013 * ViewModel class for managing permissions status. This class is designed
014 * to maintain and update permissions states as a central repository for UI
015 * controllers that may need to observe or update the status of multiple
016 * permissions. It interacts with the UI layer to propagate changes and
017 * ensures that the state persists across configuration changes.
018 *
019 * This class uses dependency injection provided by Hilt and leverages
020 * LiveData to expose its state in a lifecycle-aware manner.
021 *
022 * Key responsibilities:
023 * - Maintain the status of permissions, represented as a map where key is
024 *   the permission name and value is a boolean indicating its granted status.
025 * - Provide a LiveData object to expose permissions status to observers.
026 * - Allow updates to the permission status, triggering updates to observers
027 *   when changes occur.
028 *
029 * Dependencies, lifecycle management, and architecture principles are at
030 * the core of the design of this implementation.
031 */
032@HiltViewModel
033public class PermissionsViewModel extends ViewModel {
034
035  private final MutableLiveData<Map<String, Boolean>> permissionsStatus;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructor for the PermissionsViewModel class. This constructor initializes the
039   * {@code permissionsStatus} as a {@link MutableLiveData} instance containing an empty map.
040   * The {@code permissionsStatus} is used to represent the current status of app permissions,
041   * with the permission name as the key and the granted status (true/false) as the corresponding value.
042   *
043   * This constructor is annotated with {@link Inject} to allow for dependency injection via Hilt,
044   * ensuring proper instantiation and lifecycle management within the dependency injection framework.
045   */
046  @Inject
047  public PermissionsViewModel() {
048    permissionsStatus = new MutableLiveData<>(new HashMap<>());
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Retrieves the current permissions status, represented as a {@link LiveData} object containing a map
053   * with permission names as keys and their granted statuses (true/false) as values. This allows
054   * lifecycle-aware observers to monitor changes in the permissions status.
055   *
056   * @return a {@link LiveData} object wrapping a map where each key is a permission name
057   *         and the corresponding value is a {@code boolean} indicating whether the permission
058   *         is granted ({@code true}) or not ({@code false}).
059   */
060  public LiveData<Map<String, Boolean>> getPermissionsStatus() {
061    return permissionsStatus;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Updates the current permissions status by merging the provided map of permission names and
066   * their granted statuses into the existing permissions status map. The updated map is then
067   * set as the value of the {@code permissionsStatus} LiveData, allowing observers to be
068   * notified of the changes.
069   *
070   * @param permissionsStatus a map where each key is a permission name and the corresponding
071   *                          value is a {@code boolean} indicating whether the permission is
072   *                          granted ({@code true}) or not ({@code false}).
073   */
074  public void updatePermissionsStatus(Map<String, Boolean> permissionsStatus) {
075    Map<String, Boolean> permissions = this.permissionsStatus.getValue();
076    //noinspection DataFlowIssue
077    permissions.putAll(permissionsStatus);
078    this.permissionsStatus.setValue(permissions);
079  }
080
081}
